name: National Savings (Monthly Income  Account) Scheme
benefit:
> **Deposit Limits**

- Minimum Deposit: ₹1,000 and thereafter in multiples of ₹1,000.
- Maximum Deposit in Single Account: ₹4,50,000.
- Maximum Deposit in Minor Account/Account opened by Guardian: ₹4,50,000.
- Maximum Deposit in Joint Account: ₹9,00,000.

> **Interest**

- Interest Rate: 7.6% per annum (as specified in the 2019 notification; subject to revision by the Government from time to time
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a citizen of India. 1. The applicant must be residing in India. 1. The account may be opened by a single adult. 1. The account may be opened jointly by up to three adults. 1. A minor who has attained the age of 10 years may open and operate the account in his/her own name. 1. A guardian may open the account on behalf of a minor or a person of unsound mind.
